en: Ahahaha! So you're the kid who keeps getting in Team Aqua's way. Archie told me all about you.
We came for the research on rain. With it, we'll fill the world with sea. You won't stop us, sweetie!
Ahaha... well, aren't you a tough one. Fine, I lost. But I've still got what I came for.
Admin Shelly! Bad news! Team Magma's been seen heading for Mt. Pyre!
Magma? At Mt. Pyre? Then they're after the orbs! Everyone out, we're going to Mt. Pyre!
As for you, kid... stay out of grown-ups' business, or you'll get swept away.
Thank you! Thank you so much! I thought they'd never leave.
Please, take this Pokémon as our thanks. It's Castform. Its shape changes with the weather!
Castform was sent to the PC.
It's holding a Mystic Water, too. Raise it well, and watch how it changes in the sun and the rain.
Strange weather has been reported in Hoenn of late. Heavy rain in one place, blazing sun in another.
Castform would know all about it. Take good care of it!
Th-they want our data on rain! What could anyone want with that much rain?
